ModMetaData.name: Better Traders Guild
ModMetaData.author: Sam Hunt
ModMetaData.description: Overhaul for the Odyssey DLC Traders Guild faction. Trade at orbital bases via shuttle caravan, with rotating traders and trade request quests. A custom map generator builds lived-in settlements where entrenched garrisons defend their home, worker mechs go about their jobs, civilians shelter their children, and a hackable cargo vault links trade stock to spawned items. Also adds a smuggler's den assault quest and two new scenarios. See the Steam Workshop page for full details.
